value.condition: 7a condition 4 -- wiring producing stores to emit declared edges stays OUTSIDE D11
value.measurement: Declaring the containment row requires NO wiring: the 1344 DECLARES edges are already emitted by the store at this vintage. The registry reads them; it does not ask the store to emit anything new.

named_gap.what: the producing store emits no firm attribute on any node or edge
named_gap.note: This is the 7a condition-4 footnote case: the bridge cannot be declared admissibly without store-side change, so THAT BRIDGE is a NAMED GAP for the store's owner. Naming it is this cell's job; closing it is not, and nothing in this unit instruments anything.
